label: groupgreedy_genre15_TEST
prespecification: Plan fixed and committed before any test number existed: primary endpoint = cohort-weighted group minus global, FULL NDCG@10, K=15, all test users, paired percentile bootstrap (10,000 resamples, seed 98765). Two arms, ALL-GROUPS and FALLBACK-200 (threshold 200 VALIDATION users, the same one stage 1 flags with). One look; no variant re-runs; no post-hoc tuning of threshold, rule, pool or budget.
generous_assumption: The favourite-genre answer is treated as FREE SIDE INFORMATION: it costs NO turn and is NOT folded into the recommender, so the comparison is ITEM-FOR-ITEM at equal K. A deployed system would have to ask for it and would pay a turn. This is GENEROUS TO THE CONDITIONED ARM by construction -- every gain here is an UPPER BOUND.
